description: Sprint 3 Verification and Documentation: Verify Story 8.1 (Creator Analytics) is already complete, document notification status, document Google OAuth status, document developer login status. Commit all Sprint 3 changes and push.
steps: 1. Verify Story 8.1 Creator Analytics: Confirm getUserMetrics endpoint exists in user.controller.js (returns totalPosts, totalLikes, totalSaves). Confirm ProfileScreen.tsx calls userService.getUserMetrics and displays metrics. Mark as ALREADY COMPLETE with evidence.

2. Document notification status: The backend has notification.service.js with createNotification for like/save/follow events, broadcastNotification for admin broadcasts, and sendPushNotifications via Expo. BroadcastLog model exists. Admin broadcast history page exists. Document this as operational.

3. Document Google OAuth status: auth.routes.js has POST /auth/google with googleAuthSchema validation. auth.service.js imports OAuth2Client from google-auth-library. The code is correct - only requires GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID env var to be configured. Document as ready (config-only).

4. Document developer login: No DEV_MODE, devLogin, or developer-specific login endpoints exist. There is an admin-login endpoint (POST /auth/admin-login) that uses username/password. Document as: no separate dev login, admin login exists.

5. Stage all Sprint 3 changes. Create a single commit with message: 'feat(sprint3): popup scheduling, AI/original content badges, profile contact info, community analytics'. Push to fix/final-stabilization.

findings:
VERIFICATION RESULTS:

1. Story 8.1 Creator Analytics - COMPLETE: getUserMetrics in user.controller.js aggregates Post documents (totalPosts, totalLikes, totalSaves) with $match/$group pipeline. ProfileScreen.tsx imports userService, calls getUserMetrics in useEffect, displays results in metricsContainer with icons (grid/heart/bookmark) and labels (Posts/Likes Received/Saves Received).

2. Notifications - OPERATIONAL: notification.service.js exports createNotification (handles like/save/follow events), broadcastNotification (admin broadcasts to all users in batches of 500), sendPushNotifications imported from pushNotifications.js (Expo SDK). BroadcastLog model tracks sent broadcasts with recipientCount and push delivery stats.

3. Google OAuth - READY (config-only): POST /auth/google endpoint in auth.routes.js with googleAuthSchema validation. auth.service.js imports OAuth2Client from google-auth-library, instantiates googleClient with env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID. Fully functional once GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID env var is configured.

4. Developer Login - NO SEPARATE ENDPOINT: No DEV_MODE env var or /dev-login backend route exists. The mobile LoginScreen has a QA convenience button (handleDevLogin) that calls the existing POST /auth/admin-login endpoint with hardcoded admin credentials (admin@artnepalaya.com / admin123). Backend admin-login uses bcrypt password verification.

5. Sprint 3 commits: FEAT-001 (popup scheduling) was found uncommitted and has been committed. FEAT-002 (AI/original content badges) and FEAT-003 (profile contact info, community analytics) were already committed. All changes pushed to fix/final-stabilization.
